exercises.passage: In September, a new student joined Tal's class. His name was Artyom, and his family had just moved to Israel from Ukraine. He didn't speak much Hebrew, and during the breaks he usually sat alone and looked at his phone. Some kids said he was unfriendly, but Tal noticed that Artyom was drawing amazing pictures of football players in his notebook. One day Tal sat next to him and asked, in English, "Do you like football?" Artyom smiled for the first time. It turned out that English was the language they both knew. They talked about their favorite teams, and soon they were playing together every break. Tal helped Artyom with Hebrew, and Artyom helped Tal with his art project. By the end of the year, Artyom was speaking Hebrew with everyone. "Sometimes," Tal says, "all you need is one question."
exercises.question: Where did Artyom's family come from?
exercises.explain_he: כתוב: his family had just moved to Israel from Ukraine.
